title: Concept: Persistent login token in a response
description: A remember-me token returned in the response body in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A persistent token keeps a session alive after the password changes unless it is stored server-side and revoked, so a leaked one is a durable login that outlives the fix.
applicability: Deployments that render a remember-me token returned in the response body into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A persistent token keeps a session alive after the password changes unless it is stored server-side and revoked, so a leaked one is a durable login that outlives the fix.
